purpose: Separate static canonical V5 overlay; NEW-only schema/admission foundation, not a migration, runtime activation or full #30 enforcement claim.

columns.users.account_status: TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(account_status)='text' AND account_status IN ('active','inactive','departed'))
columns.users.auth_generation: INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(typeof(auth_generation)='integer' AND auth_generation>=1)

definitions.audit_users_INSERT: CREATE TRIGGER audit_users_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON users BEGIN INSERT INTO audit_log(occurred_at,actor,reason,entity,record_id,user_id,operation,before_json,after_json) VALUES(unixepoch(),audit_actor(),audit_reason(),'users',NEW.id,NEW.id,'INSERT',NULL,json_object('id',NEW.id,'username',NEW.username,'regelarbeitszeit',NEW.regelarbeitszeit,'ueberstunden',NEW.ueberstunden,'role',NEW.role,'department_id',NEW.department_id,'supervisor_id',NEW.supervisor_id,'account_status',NEW.account_status,'auth_generation',NEW.auth_generation)); END
definitions.audit_users_UPDATE: CREATE TRIGGER audit_users_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON users BEGIN INSERT INTO audit_log(occurred_at,actor,reason,entity,record_id,user_id,operation,before_json,after_json) VALUES(unixepoch(),audit_actor(),audit_reason(),'users',NEW.id,NEW.id,'UPDATE',json_object('id',OLD.id,'username',OLD.username,'regelarbeitszeit',OLD.regelarbeitszeit,'ueberstunden',OLD.ueberstunden,'role',OLD.role,'department_id',OLD.department_id,'supervisor_id',OLD.supervisor_id,'account_status',OLD.account_status,'auth_generation',OLD.auth_generation),json_object('id',NEW.id,'username',NEW.username,'regelarbeitszeit',NEW.regelarbeitszeit,'ueberstunden',NEW.ueberstunden,'role',NEW.role,'department_id',NEW.department_id,'supervisor_id',NEW.supervisor_id,'account_status',NEW.account_status,'auth_generation',NEW.auth_generation)); END
definitions.audit_users_DELETE: CREATE TRIGGER audit_users_DELETE AFTER DELETE ON users BEGIN INSERT INTO audit_log(occurred_at,actor,reason,entity,record_id,user_id,operation,before_json,after_json) VALUES(unixepoch(),audit_actor(),audit_reason(),'users',OLD.id,OLD.id,'DELETE',json_object('id',OLD.id,'username',OLD.username,'regelarbeitszeit',OLD.regelarbeitszeit,'ueberstunden',OLD.ueberstunden,'role',OLD.role,'department_id',OLD.department_id,'supervisor_id',OLD.supervisor_id,'account_status',OLD.account_status,'auth_generation',OLD.auth_generation),NULL); END
definitions.require_users_initial_authority_INSERT: CREATE TRIGGER require_users_initial_authority_INSERT BEFORE INSERT ON users WHEN NEW.account_status<>'active' OR NEW.auth_generation<>1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'New account authority must be explicit'); END
definitions.protect_users_authority_UPDATE: CREATE TRIGGER protect_users_authority_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON users WHEN (NEW.account_status=OLD.account_status AND NEW.auth_generation<>OLD.auth_generation) OR (NEW.account_status<>OLD.account_status AND (OLD.auth_generation=9223372036854775807 OR NEW.auth_generation<>OLD.auth_generation+1)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Account authority transition required'); END
definitions.require_terminal_grants_authority_INSERT: CREATE TRIGGER require_terminal_grants_authority_INSERT BEFORE INSERT ON terminal_grants WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id=NEW.user_id AND account_status='active' AND auth_generation=NEW.account_generation) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Current account authority required'); END
definitions.protect_terminal_grants_authority_UPDATE: CREATE TRIGGER protect_terminal_grants_authority_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON terminal_grants WHEN NEW.token_hash IS NOT OLD.token_hash OR NEW.terminal_id IS NOT OLD.terminal_id OR NEW.user_id IS NOT OLD.user_id OR NEW.credential_version IS NOT OLD.credential_version OR NEW.expires IS NOT OLD.expires OR NEW.account_generation IS NOT OLD.account_generation BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Grant authority is immutable'); END

fresh_source_contract.registration: caller-owned NEW private source, exact empty canonical rows/seeds and physical empty login_attempts; exact four-row Laravel ledger

constraints: Status changes increment authorization generation exactly once; unchanged status forbids generation reset.
SQLite storage types and values are constrained; overflow is rejected.
V5 grants require current active matching generation at INSERT and cannot change their captured authority.
V5 user audit snapshots add status/generation and exclude password/email/token.
runtime_gate: RuntimeDatabase refuses V5 reader/writer/snapshot before source filesystem access; no V4 capability alias.
remaining_acceptance: Generation-aware session/JWT/read/write/terminal enforcement, including historical receipts and sync.
Local eligible last-Admin invariant under the sole writer lock, with actual recovery acceptance.
Full fresh-file/key/setup/composition and intentionally reviewed Native new-V5 refusal.
